quote: readBounded uses os.Stat followed by os.ReadFile. This follows symlinks and does not require a regular file, and the size check and the read are separate. The sibling adapter oddtask/fsdoc is documented to read only a regular file that is not a link. A symlinked or special odd/tasks/<feature>.md is therefore read, and a FIFO would block the command.

In createHeld, if dir.Sync() fails after linkat succeeded, Create returns an error although the result file is already published under its final name. A caller that sees the error and retries gets app.ErrExists, because the file is there.
Candidate.Short slices c.Head[:12] without a length check. The zero Candidate, which the package documents as names nothing and which NewCandidate returns alongside an error, makes Short panic.
